## Appendix A

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(cluster)
library(dendextend)
```

```{r load-data}
data_url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nathanielcross04/MPP-Capstone/refs/heads/main/Data/Final%20data/Policy%20vectors%20(std)%20(nomiss).csv"

sip <- read_csv(data_url, show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r build-matrices}
years      <- 2000:2019
pol_cols   <- setdiff(names(sip), c("id_no", "state", "id", "year"))
all_states <- sort(unique(sip$id))

# One named list entry per year: a matrix with states as rows, policy vars as cols
sip_list <- setNames(
  lapply(years, function(yr) {
    sip |>
      filter(year == yr) |>
      arrange(id) |>
      column_to_rownames("id") |>
      select(all_of(pol_cols)) |>
      mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric))
  }),
  paste0("sip", substr(years, 3, 4))
)

# Euclidean distance matrices via base-R dist()
dist_list <- setNames(
  lapply(sip_list, function(df) dist(df, method = "euclidean")),
  paste0("dist", substr(years, 3, 4))
)

# Ward D2 hierarchical clustering
hc_list <- setNames(
  lapply(dist_list, function(d) hclust(d, method = "ward.D2")),
  paste0("hc", substr(years, 3, 4))
)
```

### Faceted Dendrograms (2000–2019)

```{r dendrograms, fig.height=14, fig.width=11}
par(
  mfrow = c(5, 4),
  mar   = c(3, 2, 2, 1),
  oma   = c(1, 1, 3, 1)
)

for (yr in years) {
  key <- paste0("hc", substr(yr, 3, 4))
  plot(
    hc_list[[key]],
    main  = as.character(yr),
    xlab  = "",
    ylab  = "",
    sub   = "",
    cex   = 0.40,
    hang  = -1
  )
}

mtext(
  "Hierarchical Clustering of State Policy Distances (2000–2019)",
  outer = TRUE, cex = 1.1, font = 2, line = 1
)

par(mfrow = c(1, 1), mar = c(5, 4, 4, 2), oma = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
```

### Faceted Silhouette Scores (2000–2019)

```{r silhouette, fig.height=14, fig.width=11}
# Pre-compute all scores to fix a shared y-axis
all_scores <- sapply(years, function(yr) {
  key <- paste0("hc", substr(yr, 3, 4))
  dkey <- paste0("dist", substr(yr, 3, 4))
  sapply(2:10, function(k) {
    s <- silhouette(cutree(hc_list[[key]], k = k), dist_list[[dkey]])
    mean(s[, "sil_width"])
  })
})

y_lo <- floor(min(all_scores)   * 20) / 20
y_hi <- ceiling(max(all_scores) * 20) / 20

par(
  mfrow = c(5, 4),
  mar   = c(4, 4, 3, 1),
  oma   = c(1, 1, 3, 1)
)

for (i in seq_along(years)) {
  yr   <- years[i]
  key  <- paste0("hc",   substr(yr, 3, 4))
  dkey <- paste0("dist", substr(yr, 3, 4))

  sil_scores <- sapply(2:10, function(k) {
    s <- silhouette(cutree(hc_list[[key]], k = k), dist_list[[dkey]])
    mean(s[, "sil_width"])
  })

  best_k <- which.max(sil_scores) + 1   # index 1 == k=2

  plot(
    2:10, sil_scores,
    type     = "b",
    pch      = 19,
    cex      = 0.6,
    xlab     = "Number of clusters (k)",
    ylab     = "Mean silhouette width",
    main     = as.character(yr),
    ylim     = c(y_lo, y_hi),
    cex.main = 0.9,
    cex.lab  = 0.7,
    cex.axis = 0.65
  )

  abline(v = best_k, lty = 2, col = "firebrick", lwd = 0.8)

  text(
    x      = best_k,
    y      = max(sil_scores) - 0.02,
    labels = paste0("k=", best_k),
    cex    = 0.6,
    col    = "firebrick",
    pos    = 4
  )
}

mtext(
  "Silhouette Scores by Year (2000–2019)",
  outer = TRUE, cex = 1.1, font = 2, line = 1
)

par(mfrow = c(1, 1), mar = c(5, 4, 4, 2), oma = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
```
